title: MattisTeams
body:
MattisTeams – Advanced Team & Clan System (Folia Ready)

Overview
MattisTeams is a next-generation team management solution specifically built for high-performance Paper and Folia server environments. Designed for efficiency and scalability, it allows your players to form alliances, manage shared resources, and coordinate through integrated team features without impacting server performance. With a full GUI-driven interface and deep permission control, it offers a professional experience for both players and administrators.

Key Features
Full Folia Support utilizing regional async schedulers to ensure zero-lag team operations even on massive server clusters.
GUI-Driven Interface providing an intuitive and modern way for players to manage their team settings, members, and permissions.
Integrated Team Home System allowing teams to set a shared headquarters with asynchronous teleportation logic.
Team Chat Engine enabling private communication channels for team members to strategize in real-time.
Smart PVP Toggling giving team leaders the power to enable or disable friendly fire within their ranks.
Advanced Admin Tools providing server owners with complete control to override, rename, or delete teams for moderation.

Commands and Permissions
/team [t] - Main access point for team management - Permission mattisteams.use
/teams - List all active server teams - Permission mattisteams.use
/teamadmin [ta] - Full administrative control over all teams - Permission mattisteams.admin

Player Permissions:
- mattisteams.create: Allows creating a new team.
- mattisteams.home.set: Allows setting the shared team home.
- mattisteams.home.teleport: Allows teleporting to the team home.
- mattisteams.chat: Access to the private team chat.
- mattisteams.gui: Access to the interactive team management GUI.
- mattisteams.pvp.toggle: Control over friendly fire settings.

Technical Specifications
Asynchronous Teleportation Logic ensuring world-loading doesn't freeze the main tick during home teleports.
Optimized Data Handling using concurrent collections for thread-safe member management on Folia.
Adventure API Integration for beautiful, modern text components and HEX color support.
Scalable Architecture designed to handle hundreds of teams and thousands of players simultaneously.

Installation
1. Drop the MattisTeams jar into your /plugins/ directory.
2. Ensure your server is running Java 21 and Paper/Folia 1.21.
3. Restart the server and configure your team limits in the config.yml.
4. Set up permissions through your favorite permission plugin (e.g., LuckPerms).
